title: Bright light over Catalina identified as the ISS

tellings.quote: And then we discovered that that bright light was the space station.

plain: During a 2021 skywatching effort over the Catalina Channel, the stretch of sea off Southern California, the team saw a bright light that they later found was the International Space Station. The scientist Kevin Knuth, who was there, tells this, and he mentions a fellow researcher named Matthew Szydagis and a scientific paper written about the mission. He tells it to show the team checked what they saw and ruled out ordinary things.
